# LA245's policy

The agent that lives in this folder works by these rules. One rule per bullet: `- [mode] source: what to do`.
Mode is off, watch or do. Watch: everything runs, but nothing leaves this folder, and what it would have shown you is
kept as a "would have shown" card on the folder's page (http://127.0.0.1:7777/agent/la245). Every rule here starts in watch.

- [watch] blackboard: every night at 03:00 read the course; new or changed → "today we do" with where each thing lives and its fine print; a new deck → notes + 3 questions in made/ and the rule bank grows; an exam date → the exam plan rebuilt to it.
- [watch] clock: 19:30 tonight's block from exam/schedule.md: the hypos on the desk; grade what I answer against exam/grader.md; weak.md and one sheet line.
- [watch] clock: 09:40 on a class day (Tue/Thu): the notes and 3 questions for today's class, pinned.
- [watch] folder: a new file in material/ → read it into brain.md and the bank.
- [watch, draft] mail: BU mail every 60 min 08:00–22:00: new messages from Prof. Lomax, Team 3 or about LA245 into mail.md; one that needs my answer → a draft in drafts/ in my voice and a card "Reply to …".
- [watch, draft] teams: every 60 min 08:00–22:00 Teams chats and mentions from LA245's people into teams.md; one that needs my answer → a draft in drafts/ and a card "Reply to …".
